description: Register a ChurnZeroResource wrapping ChurnZero's REST API v1 (account-specific base URL, HTTP Basic auth) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Your ChurnZero tenant's API base URL (account-specific -- find on Admin -> API Keys page). e.g. 'https://yourtenant.churnzero.net'

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var holding your ChurnZero login email (Basic auth username)

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the ChurnZero API key (Basic auth password)

name: ChurnZero Resource
